title: SmartEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated Smart Contracts from Natural Language Specifications
authors_zh: Abhinav Goel, Agostino Capponi, Alfio Gliozzo, Chaitya Shah
paper_type_zh: 智能合约生成质量评测与安全审计数据集
best_for_zh: 研究代码生成、智能合约安全或代码质量 judge 的读者。
one_line: SmartEval evaluates 9,000 LLM-generated Solidity contracts using references, audits, and a five-dimensional quality rubric.
SmartEval 用专家实现、五维 rubric、审计和编译记录，系统评测 9,000 份 LLM 生成 Solidity 合约的质量。
why: It provides grounded, reproducible quality signals for code-generation and security judges.
inclusion_reason: SmartEval couples generated contracts with reference implementations, expert-validated rubrics, audits, and compilation outcomes.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Smart-contract generation is often evaluated by compilation or a few tests, yet contracts may omit business logic, use wrong variables, or implement incorrect state transitions, creating irreversible financial risk. Code similarity also does not show whether natural-language specifications are faithfully implemented.

SmartEval builds a large generated-contract corpus and five-dimensional rubric and validates automated scoring through LLM auditing, expert evaluation, and Slither static analysis.

智能合约生成评测常只检查能否编译或通过少量测试，但合约可能遗漏业务逻辑、使用错误变量或实现错误状态转移，仍带来不可逆资产风险。代码相似度也不能判断自然语言规格是否被忠实实现。

SmartEval 建立大规模生成合约语料和五维 rubric，并结合 LLM 审计、专家评估与 Slither 静态分析验证自动评分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: SmartEval releases 9,000 generated Solidity contracts paired with expert implementations from FSMSCG. Its five-dimensional rubric covers functional completeness, variable fidelity, state-machine correctness, business-logic fidelity, and code quality. The data retain generation models, prompts, automated audits, compilation/security analysis, and scores, supporting smart-contract judges, quality audits, and security-error analysis.
SmartEval 公开 9,000 份 Solidity 生成合约，并与 FSMSCG 中专家实现配对。五维 rubric 覆盖功能完整性、变量忠实度、状态机正确性、业务逻辑忠实度和代码质量；数据保留生成模型、提示、自动审计、编译/安全分析与评分记录。它适合智能合约 Judge、生成质量审计和安全错误分析。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select specifications and gold: Natural-language specifications and expert implementations from FSMSCG serve as inputs and references for 9,000 generations.
  1. Generate contracts: Several LLMs generate Solidity contracts under standard prompts and configurations with metadata.
  1. Five-dimensional evaluation: An LLM auditor scores functionality, variables, state machines, business logic, and code quality.
  1. External validation: Three experts review scores and Slither checks security issues; compiler, auditor, and specification versions must be fixed.

1. 选择规格与金标： 从 FSMSCG 获取自然语言规格和专家实现，作为 9,000 次生成的共同输入与参考。
  1. 多模型生成： 在统一提示与配置下让多个 LLM 生成 Solidity 合约，并记录元数据。
  1. 五维评价： LLM auditor 按功能、变量、状态机、业务逻辑和代码质量逐项评分。
  1. 外部验证： 三名专家复核分数，Slither 检查安全问题；复现需固定编译器、审计模型和规格版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Three Columbia PhD experts agree with automated scores within 0.34 points on average, and LLM-auditor security judgments agree with Slither 79.4% of the time. Among 9,000 contracts, logic omissions account for 35.3% and state-transition errors 23.4%. Generated contracts score 8.29 composite points above expert implementations because of literal specification following, not necessarily greater safety. The rubric is diagnostic but can reward misleading strengths.
三名 Columbia 博士专家的评价与自动分数平均相差不超过 0.34 分，LLM auditor 与 Slither 的安全判断一致率为 79.4%。9,000 份合约中，逻辑遗漏占 35.3%，状态转移错误占 23.4%；生成合约比专家实现高 8.29 个综合分被解释为更字面遵循规格，而非实际更安全。结果证明 rubric 有诊断性，也暴露自动高分陷阱。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier smart-contract benchmarks rely on compilation, tests, or static vulnerability scans and poorly assess business-specification fidelity. SmartEval combines natural-language specifications, expert implementations, five-dimensional rubrics, LLM auditing, and rule-based tools. The novelty is joint functional-semantic and security evaluation rather than simply more generated samples.
既有智能合约基准依赖编译、测试或静态漏洞扫描，难以评业务规格忠实性。SmartEval 将自然语言规格、专家实现、五维 rubric、LLM 审计和规则工具放入同一评测管线。新意是同时评价功能语义和安全，而不是仅增加更多生成样本。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: FSMSCG specifications and state-machine tasks do not represent all DeFi or complex protocols.
  1. Limitation 2: Both LLM auditors and Slither can miss economic attacks and cross-contract vulnerabilities.
  1. Limitation 3: Composite scores may let literal compliance hide unsafe design and should not be release gates alone.

1. 局限1： FSMSCG 规格和状态机任务不能代表全部 DeFi 与复杂链上协议。
  1. 局限2： LLM auditor 与 Slither 均可能漏掉经济攻击和跨合约漏洞。
  1. 局限3： 综合分会让字面规格遵循掩盖不安全设计，不能单独作为发布门槛。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Compare natural-language-to-Solidity systems on functional, state-machine, and security errors.
  1. Use case 2: Use 9,000 contracts to train code judges while retaining rule tools and expert test sets.
  1. Use case 3: Before deployment, add unit tests, formal verification, audits, and economic-attack simulation.

1. 使用场景1： 比较自然语言到 Solidity 系统的功能、状态机和安全错误。
  1. 使用场景2： 用 9,000 份合约训练代码 Judge，但需保留规则工具和专家测试集。
  1. 使用场景3： 真实部署前必须增加单元测试、形式验证、审计和经济攻击模拟。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Audit 9,000 generated smart contracts with five-dimensional rubrics and external tools.
  2. Method: FSMSCG specifications, multi-model generation, LLM auditor, experts, and Slither.
  3. Data: Generated code, expert implementations, compilation, security, and scores are public.
  4. Evidence: Expert difference 0.34, Slither agreement 79.4%, logic omissions 35.3%.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for contract judges; composite scores cannot replace security verification.

1. 一句话定位： 以五维 rubric 和外部工具审计 9,000 份生成智能合约。
  2. 方法抓手： FSMSCG 规格、多模型生成、LLM auditor、专家和 Slither。
  3. 数据抓手： 生成代码、专家实现、编译、安全和评分记录公开。
  4. 证据锚点： 专家差异 0.34、Slither 一致率 79.4%、逻辑遗漏 35.3%。
  5. 复用决定： 适合合约 Judge；综合分不能替代安全验证。
